description: This file defines a DOM walker utility class for traversing DOM nodes within a specified range, including methods for forward and backward traversal, boundary checks, and node filtering based on styles and attributes, used within the CKEditor project.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.walker
classes.description: A utility class for walking through DOM nodes within a specified range, with methods for traversal, boundary checking, and node filtering.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Stops the walking process, preventing further nodes from being retrieved.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next node in the traversal.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Retrieves the previous node in the traversal.

methods.name: checkForward
methods.description: Checks all nodes forward, executing the evaluator function, returns false if any evaluation fails.

methods.name: checkBackward
methods.description: Checks all nodes backward, executing the evaluator function, returns false if any evaluation fails.

methods.name: lastForward
methods.description: Performs a full forward traversal and returns the last valid node.

methods.name: lastBackward
methods.description: Performs a full backward traversal and returns the last valid node.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the walker state, clearing current node and internal flags.
